candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model - 2m
verified_facts: The 2m composite DSM includes surface-object heights such as vehicles, buildings and vegetation together with terrain.
The composite merges and resamples source surveys and uses the newest best-resolution data where repeats exist; contributing surveys carry the +/-15cm RMSE vertical-accuracy statement.
semantic_limits: A DSM pixel cannot be used as bare-earth parcel elevation without a validated ground classification or DTM lineage, and composite resampling does not improve source vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model - 1m
verified_facts: The 1m composite DTM removes surface objects using bespoke algorithms and manual editing to represent terrain.

It combines Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys, uses newest best-resolution data for repeats and bilinear interpolation where resampled; source surveys are stated at +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: The 1m DTM is the appropriate surface class for ground-height work but still requires parcel-specific survey lineage, date, transformation, pixel selection and uncertainty handling.
